breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states both 'The k-point grid must be gamma-centered' AND 'The k-point grid must use a half shift' simultaneously. This directly repeats the original inconsistency from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes the gamma-centered requirement entirely, keeping only the half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. The agent failed to resolve this contradiction and instead preserved both conflicting instructions.
